## Meet our Logistics Employee LKQ RHIAG Switzerland Kjire Panovski


I have always wanted to become a forklift truck driver, and this year thanks to LKQ DACH, I will be able to make my professional goal come true, as I have been selected for further development training along with a few other colleagues from my company. Currently I am working in the logistics department, I take care of receipting of goods and returns from our customers. What keeps me motivated daily, is not only that I like and understand our business very well, but also the excellent communication and relationship with the team – both during working hours, but also outside of work, where we sometimes spend time together playing darts and pool. To me, being able to grow in a place where I dedicate my time is very important. And with LKQ I feel we can grow together.


> LKQ RHIAG Switzerland helps me further develop my working skills.


KJIRE PANOVSKI Logistics LKQ RHIAG Switzerland
